source: docs/reports/2026-09-07-esp-emu-c6-spike.md §11.1; the spike planning directory's desk-captures/emu-harness5-run.stdout (the emulator's harness/5/run.stdout)
capture: esp-emu --chip esp32c6 --firmware harness.bin --timeout 90s --exit-on '=== DONE ===' --log-color never, on the merged image built from the same ELF the desk flashed. Install per spike report §10: a checksum-verified release asset from espressif/esp-emulator v0.42.0, installed outside the repository.
note: This transcript predates the in-band [fw-checks-header] line, so this sidecar is the whole header. The silicon_rev and mac here are the emulator's SYNTHETIC values, not the board's: esp-emu's eFuse reports chip revision v0.3 on a v0.2 board and a fixed MAC. They are recorded as captured rather than corrected, because a header that quietly reported the board's values would hide a real fidelity gap (spike report §8). Ratios in the replay are silicon divided by this side.

trust.because: byte-equal to silicon on the same image: peak/resident/after-drop 48,132/18,932/3,976 B and all 184 per-tick values (spike report §11.1); meteor load gate 216,056 B (§11.2)
same words and values as silicon, different columns — the intercepted ROM printf drops width and zero-pad flags, and bootloader stamps are 4-51 ms here against 23-235 ms on the board

no cycle model. Ticks 1-18 run 2.37x faster than silicon and ticks 19-92 14.5x, because the ROM UART drains for free here; the harness's own 5 ms slice budget PASSES here and FAILS on the board (spike report §11.1)
asserts SOF forever and reports EP1 free forever, so the shipped firmware serves into the void believing a host is attached (spike report §4). Never trust a USB-SJ claim from here
no pin observation: RMT frames are produced and vanish, and IO_MUX is modeled only to GPIO15 while the WS281x pin is GPIO18 (spike report §8)
the masked UART0 walk transcript is content-identical to silicon's (spike report §11.3)
